prompt:
超写实咖啡店街拍人像摄影，竖版约 2:3，两名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，并排坐在咖啡店临街落地窗后的高脚椅上，摄影者站在店外隔着玻璃拍摄。采用约 50–70mm 等效镜头，机位略低于人物腰部并轻微向上，完整拍到两人的头部、上半身、大腿、小腿和长靴，同时保留玻璃窗框、咖啡店室内与右上角绿色圆形品牌灯牌，整体像自然抓拍而不是摆拍写真。

两人都为中小骨架、自然纤细偏轻沙漏身材，肩部偏窄，腰部收束，大腿有真实柔软体积，腿部修长。两人坐姿自然放松，膝盖朝前，双腿略微分开，不要夸张姿势。

左侧人物留深棕黑色超长微卷发，长度到腰部附近，中分偏侧分，发尾自然大波浪。脸转向右侧好友，露出明显自然笑容，眼神看对方。右手举着一杯透明塑料冰咖啡，绿色吸管靠近嘴边，左手自然放在杯子或腿侧。上身穿奶油白 / 浅米色贴身长袖针织上衣，领口偏低圆领或 U 领，面料有细密罗纹。下身穿深灰黑＋米白色混纺粗花呢超短裙 / tweed mini skirt，裙身略有结构感，前方带几枚金色圆形装饰扣。脚穿黑色及膝皮靴，靴筒略宽松，有自然褶皱，低跟或粗跟。

右侧人物留浅棕 / 蜂蜜棕色长卷发，长度到胸口以下，带轻薄刘海和自然波浪。身体略朝左侧人物转，右手托住下巴，手肘靠近桌面或身体侧边，脸上带开朗露齿笑容，目光看向左侧好友。上身穿浅米白色粗针织开衫 / 毛衣外套，里面是灰米色低领修身针织连衣裙或长款上衣，整体同色系、柔软贴身。脚穿黑色中筒至及膝皮靴，靴筒柔软略皱。

两人面前或旁边各有一杯透明塑料杯冰咖啡 / 奶咖，杯身带绿色圆形咖啡品牌标识，绿色吸管清楚可见。右侧人物旁边放一只浅灰米色迷你手提包，带金属链条或细肩带。

场景为临街星巴克风格咖啡店二楼 / 高窗座位。人物坐在贴近大面积落地窗的高脚椅上，窗框为深灰黑色金属结构，玻璃表面有轻微反射。右上角画面进入一部分巨大的绿色圆形咖啡店灯牌；下方窗外边缘可见黑底白字品牌招牌的一部分。

咖啡店室内为暖灰、木色和米白色调，顶部有数盏暖黄色圆形射灯。人物背后有其他顾客的模糊身影，墙面上可见类似 “Good Coffee Brighter Lives” 的浅色装饰文字，但不要要求文字完全准确。玻璃和窗框在人物腰部附近形成一条横向栏杆 / 窗框线，增加真实隔窗拍摄感。

光线为阴天自然窗光＋咖啡店暖色室内灯光。人物脸部和皮肤柔和明亮，整体偏自然暖白；背景稍暗，玻璃有轻微雾感和反射。不要强直闪，不要电影级布光。

整体呈 高质量日系街拍 / 咖啡店自然抓拍质感：轻微柔焦、低对比、自然肤色、玻璃带少量灰雾反射，背景基本可辨但不抢主体，不要过度 HDR 或强人像模式虚化。

重点锁定：两名成年东亚女性＋隔着咖啡店落地玻璃拍摄＋并排坐高脚椅＋彼此对视笑＋左侧深色长卷发拿冰咖啡＋奶油白长袖上衣＋粗花呢短裙＋金色扣＋黑色及膝靴＋右侧浅棕长卷发托腮笑＋米白针织开衫＋灰米修身连衣裙＋黑色长靴＋两杯透明冰咖啡＋绿色吸管＋右上大型绿色圆形咖啡店灯牌＋暖色店内灯光＋自然日系抓拍。

避免：单人构图、两人都看镜头、短发、高马尾、运动装、牛仔裤、丝袜、运动鞋、高跟细靴、空咖啡店、室外坐姿、夜店灯光、强闪光、过度磨皮、动漫脸、CG 感、多余人物肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en: Ultra-realistic coffee shop street snap portrait photography, vertical aspect ratio approximately 2:3, two distinctly adult East Asian women, 20+, sitting side by side on high bar stools behind the coffee shop's street-facing floor-to-ceiling window, photographed by a photographer standing outside looking in through the glass. Captured with an equivalent ~50–70mm lens, camera angle slightly lower than their waists and angled subtly upward, fully capturing both subjects' heads, upper bodies, thighs, calves, and tall boots, while retaining the glass window frames, the coffee shop interior, and a green circular branded light sign in the upper right corner, appearing overall like a natural candid snapshot rather than a posed photoshoot. Both subjects have small-to-medium bone structures, naturally slender with subtle soft hourglass figures, narrower shoulders, tapered waists, realistic soft thigh volume, and long legs. Both maintain natural, relaxed sitting postures with knees facing forward and legs slightly parted, avoiding exaggerated poses. The subject on the left has ultra-long, slightly wavy deep brownish-black hair reaching near her waist, with a center-to-side part and natural loose waves at the ends. Her face is turned toward her friend on the right, showing a clear, natural smile while looking at her. Her right hand holds a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a green straw brought close to her mouth, while her left hand rests naturally on the cup or beside her thigh. She wears a cream-white / light beige fitted long-sleeved knit top with a low scoop or U-neckline made of finely ribbed fabric. On her lower body, she wears a dark grey-black and off-white tweed mini skirt with subtle structure and several golden circular decorative buttons on the front. On her feet are black knee-high leather boots with slightly loose shafts, natural creasing, and low or block heels. The subject on the right has long wavy light brown / honey brown hair falling below the chest, with light wispy bangs and natural waves. Her body is turned slightly toward the woman on the left, resting her chin on her right hand with her elbow near the tabletop or side of her body, showing a cheerful open-mouthed smile as she looks at her friend on the left. She wears an off-white chunky knit cardigan / sweater coat over a grey-beige low-neck form-fitting knit dress or long top, cohesive in tone, soft and body-hugging. On her feet are black mid-calf to knee-high leather boots with soft, slightly slouchy shafts. In front of or beside each woman is a clear plastic cup of iced coffee / latte featuring a green circular coffee brand logo, with green straws clearly visible. Beside the right-hand subject rests a light grey-beige mini handbag with a metal chain or thin shoulder strap. The setting is second-floor / high-window street-front seating of a Starbucks-style coffee shop. The subjects sit on high stools close to expansive floor-to-ceiling windows with dark grey-black metal framing, featuring subtle reflections across the glass surface. Part of a massive green circular coffee shop illuminated logo enters the frame in the upper right; along the outer edge below the window, part of a branded sign with white lettering on a black background is visible. The coffee shop interior features warm grey, wood, and off-white tones, with several warm yellow circular spotlights on the ceiling. Blurred silhouettes of other patrons are visible behind the subjects, and faint decorative wall lettering resembling 'Good Coffee Brighter Lives' appears on the wall, without requiring exact textual accuracy. The glass and window frame create a horizontal bar / mullion line near the subjects' waist levels, enhancing the authentic feel of shooting through a window. Lighting consists of overcast natural window light combined with the warm interior illumination of the coffee shop. The subjects' faces and skin are soft and bright, generally leaning toward a natural warm white; the background is slightly darker, and the glass carries subtle haze and reflections. No harsh direct flash, no theatrical cinematic lighting. Overall texture exhibits high-quality Japanese street snap / natural coffee shop candid characteristics: slight soft focus, low contrast, natural skin tones, glass with a touch of hazy reflection, and a background that remains discernible without distracting from the subjects, free from excessive HDR or aggressive portrait mode blur. Key focus: two adult East Asian women + shot through coffee shop floor-to-ceiling glass + sitting side-by-side on high stools + smiling and looking at each other + left: dark long wavy hair holding iced coffee + cream-white long-sleeved top + tweed mini skirt + gold buttons + black knee-high boots + right: light brown long wavy hair resting chin smiling + off-white knit cardigan + grey-beige fitted dress + black tall boots + two clear iced coffees + green straws + large green circular coffee shop light sign in upper right + warm interior lighting + natural Japanese candid style. Avoid: solo composition, both looking at camera, short hair, high ponytail, sportswear, jeans, pantyhose, sneakers, stiletto high-heeled boots, empty coffee shop, outdoor seating, nightclub lighting, harsh flash, excessive skin smoothing, anime face, CG look, extra limbs, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Japanese-style street snap portrait prompt of two young women sitting side-by-side inside a coffee shop floor-to-ceiling window, drinking coffee and chatting.

左侧人物留深棕黑色超长微卷发，长度到腰部附近，中分偏侧分，发尾自然大波浪。脸转向右侧好友，露出明显自然笑容，眼神看对方。右手举着一杯透明塑料冰咖啡，绿色吸管靠近嘴边，左手自然放在杯子或腿侧。上身穿奶油白 / 浅米色贴身长袖针织上衣，领口偏低圆领或 U 领，面料有细密罗纹。下身穿深灰黑＋米白色混纺粗花呢超短裙 / tweed mini skirt，裙身略有结构感，前方带几枚金色圆形装饰扣。脚穿黑色及膝皮靴，靴筒略宽松，有自然褶皱，低跟或粗跟。

右侧人物留浅棕 / 蜂蜜棕色长卷发，长度到胸口以下，带轻薄刘海和自然波浪。身体略朝左侧人物转，右手托住下巴，手肘靠近桌面或身体侧边，脸上带开朗露齿笑容，目光看向左侧好友。上身穿浅米白色粗针织开衫 / 毛衣外套，里面是灰米色低领修身针织连衣裙或长款上衣，整体同色系、柔软贴身。脚穿黑色中筒至及膝皮靴，靴筒柔软略皱。

两人面前或旁边各有一杯透明塑料杯冰咖啡 / 奶咖，杯身带绿色圆形咖啡品牌标识，绿色吸管清楚可见。右侧人物旁边放一只浅灰米色迷你手提包，带金属链条或细肩带。

场景为临街星巴克风格咖啡店二楼 / 高窗座位。人物坐在贴近大面积落地窗的高脚椅上，窗框为深灰黑色金属结构，玻璃表面有轻微反射。右上角画面进入一部分巨大的绿色圆形咖啡店灯牌；下方窗外边缘可见黑底白字品牌招牌的一部分。

咖啡店室内为暖灰、木色和米白色调，顶部有数盏暖黄色圆形射灯。人物背后有其他顾客的模糊身影，墙面上可见类似 “Good Coffee Brighter Lives” 的浅色装饰文字，但不要要求文字完全准确。玻璃和窗框在人物腰部附近形成一条横向栏杆 / 窗框线，增加真实隔窗拍摄感。

光线为阴天自然窗光＋咖啡店暖色室内灯光。人物脸部和皮肤柔和明亮，整体偏自然暖白；背景稍暗，玻璃有轻微雾感和反射。不要强直闪，不要电影级布光。

整体呈 高质量日系街拍 / 咖啡店自然抓拍质感：轻微柔焦、低对比、自然肤色、玻璃带少量灰雾反射，背景基本可辨但不抢主体，不要过度 HDR 或强人像模式虚化。

重点锁定：两名成年东亚女性＋隔着咖啡店落地玻璃拍摄＋并排坐高脚椅＋彼此对视笑＋左侧深色长卷发拿冰咖啡＋奶油白长袖上衣＋粗花呢短裙＋金色扣＋黑色及膝靴＋右侧浅棕长卷发托腮笑＋米白针织开衫＋灰米修身连衣裙＋黑色长靴＋两杯透明冰咖啡＋绿色吸管＋右上大型绿色圆形咖啡店灯牌＋暖色店内灯光＋自然日系抓拍。

避免：单人构图、两人都看镜头、短发、高马尾、运动装、牛仔裤、丝袜、运动鞋、高跟细靴、空咖啡店、室外坐姿、夜店灯光、强闪光、过度磨皮、动漫脸、CG 感、多余人物肢体、水印和乱码文字。
translations.en: Hyperrealistic street portrait photography of two East Asian women in their 20s, sitting side by side on high chairs behind a floor-to-ceiling window of a Starbucks-style cafe, shot from outside through the glass with a 50-70mm equivalent lens. Natural candid snapshot aesthetic, showing their full bodies down to black knee-high boots, warm indoor lighting, and brand signage reflections.
